description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hetutetiya East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820004
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land ownership information, property boundaries, and legal determinations about land titles, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification category.
